evidence.title: GitHub - react-hook-form/react-hook-form: 📋 React Hooks for form state management and validation (Web + React Native) · GitHub

name: React Hook Form
summary: React Hooks for form state management and validation on web and React Native.
description: Form state management and validation for React and React Native through hooks: register inputs, validate with native HTML rules or resolver libraries (Yup, Zod, AJV, Superstruct, Joi), and submit with minimal re-renders. It is dependency-free, integrates with UI libraries out of the box, and its site adds a form builder, API reference, FAQs and examples.
contains: form state management and validation through hooks
resolvers for Yup, Zod, AJV, Superstruct and Joi
no dependencies; embraces native HTML validation
form builder, API reference and examples on the site
